sentence: This project tries to find out why some children with hearing loss develop typical communication skills while others face delays.
This project tests a sequencing method to find genetic variants that cause rare diseases in people whose disease is unexplained.
This project builds mathematical models of how tumors grow and respond to treatment, using patient and experimental data.
This project tries to build an oral vaccine that blocks the spread of several tick-borne pathogens from infected ticks to hosts.
This project provides proteomics technologies used in cancer research, such as interactome mapping and cell surfaceome profiling.
This project studies how mutations in an RNA-binding protein affect tumor progression and inflammation in colorectal cancer, using mouse and organoid models.
This project builds a cultured skin tissue platform to study how bacteria, fungi and viruses on skin interact with skin cells.
This project tries to find out where pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma starts and which genes and signals drive its progression.
This project studies the molecular mechanisms that let large dense-core vesicles fuse, and how problems with fusion contribute to diseases.
This project tries to build a better tuberculosis vaccine by genetically modifying the vaccine that is available now.
This project maps how proteins interact and how genes work together in breast, head and neck, and lung cancer.
This project builds a 3D microscope that images fatty acids in live cells to study how they affect breast cancer metastasis.
This project runs a randomized trial of a digital intervention to see its effect on HIV prevention in youth experiencing homelessness.
This project develops approaches to probe what thousands of transcription factor isoforms do at once in breast cancer cells.
This project tries to find out how iron and lipid dysregulation changes the function of microglia in neurodegenerative diseases.
This project studies gene variants in mice and humans that are linked to risk of diabetic kidney disease.
This project sequences and maps viruses in human samples to understand the human virome and how it changes over time.
This project tries to find out how lipid homeostasis is connected to proteostasis inside cells.
This project builds and studies mouse models of Late-Onset Alzheimer’s Disease and distributes them to the scientific community.
This project supports basic and translational research on the molecular mechanisms of hematopoiesis and on therapies for non-malignant blood diseases.
